Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message is used to signal a ring wide event.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds portion of timestamp: whole seconds after midnight US Eastern Time (0 to 86400)

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp (0 to 999999999)

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: CTI version, decoded as Mn (major, minor): currently set to 21

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes

Message.Name: Options Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, the exchange disseminates directory messages for all symbols trading on a given ring. Sent once per symbol, typically before the Start of System Hours System Event; intra-day updates are sent as they occur. 48 bytes.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds portion of timestamp: whole seconds after midnight US Eastern Time (0 to 86400)

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp (0 to 999999999)

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: CTI version, decoded as Mn (major, minor): currently set to 20 (as printed)

Field.Name: Option Id
Field.Description: Option id assigned by exchange daily

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option root symbol

Field.Name: Expiration
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option: Bits 0-6 = Year (0-99), Bits 7-10 = Month (1-12), Bits 11-15 = Day (1-31); bit 15 is the least significant bit

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Strike price of the option: fixed point with 4 decimal digits

Field.Name: Option Kind
Field.Description: C = Call, P = Put

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Connection source: 0 = Away trade Connection, 1-N = Local trade connection

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying stock symbol (left justified, space filled)

Field.Name: Option Closing Type
Field.Description: N = Normal hours, L = Late hours, W = WCO Early Closing at 12:00 Noon (PHLX Only)

Field.Name: Tradable
Field.Description: Y = Option is tradable, N = Option is not tradable

Field.Name: Mpv
Field.Description: Minimum Price Variation for this option: E = penny Everywhere, S = Scaled, P = penny Pilot

Field.Name: Closing Only
Field.Description: Y = Option is Closing Position Only (only MM origin orders can have open position in the series), N = Option is not Closing Position Only

Field.Name: Contract Size
Field.Description: Underlying Deliverable size

Message.Name: Security Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Indicates the current trading status of an option within the exchange. A T (Trading resumed) message is sent for all options eligible for trading at the start of system hours; a security absent from the pre-opening spin should be treated as halted. 27 bytes.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds portion of timestamp: whole seconds after midnight US Eastern Time (0 to 86400)

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp (0 to 999999999)

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: CTI version, decoded as Mn (major, minor): currently set to 20 (as printed)

Field.Name: Option Id
Field.Description: Option id assigned by exchange daily

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option root symbol

Field.Name: Expiration
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option: Bits 0-6 = Year (0-99), Bits 7-10 = Month (1-12), Bits 11-15 = Day (1-31); bit 15 is the least significant bit

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Strike price of the option: fixed point with 4 decimal digits

Field.Name: Option Kind
Field.Description: C = Call, P = Put

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Current trading state for the option on the exchange: H = Halt in effect, T = Trading resumed

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Clearing trades and trade corrections, with contra side clearing information (trade cancels too when a firm and connection block is configured for extended cancels, Transaction Type Z). 330 bytes. Contra side clearing fields carry a Contra prefix.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds portion of trade time

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of trade time

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: CTI version: currently set to 20 (as printed)

Field.Name: Send Type
Field.Description: S = Send (original transmission), P = Possible duplicate (unsolicited retransmission)

Field.Name: Option Id
Field.Description: Option id assigned by exchange daily. Zero for stock leg.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying stock symbol (left justified, space filled)

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option root symbol. Blank for stock leg.

Field.Name: Expiration
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option: Bits 0-6 = Year (0-99), Bits 7-10 = Month (1-12), Bits 11-15 = Day (1-31); bit 15 is the least significant bit. Zero for stock leg.

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Strike price of the option: fixed point with 4 decimal digits. Zero for stock leg.

Field.Name: Option Kind
Field.Description: C = Call, P = Put, space = Stock leg

Field.Name: Trade Flags
Field.Description: Symbol flags: Bit 0 Penny Pilot, Bit 1 Make/Take Program, Bit 2 Single Listed, Bit 3 Weekly Expiration, Bit 4 Monthly Expiration, Bit 5 Quarterly Expiration (bits 2 to 5 available at a future date), Bits 6-15 not used; bit 15 is the least significant bit

Field.Name: Transaction Type
Field.Description: X = new trade, Y = trade correction, Z = trade cancel (if trade cancel messages are to be sent using this message)

Field.Name: Liquidity
Field.Description: See Liquidity Codes

Field.Name: Trade Id
Field.Description: Clearing trade Id. Coupled with correction number and trade side uniquely identifies a clearing trade for a given day.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number. 0 for new trades. Used to identify version of the trade being corrected; increments by 1 for each subsequent correction.

Field.Name: Cross Id
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all clearing trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine. 0 if cross id is not available.

Field.Name: Match Id
Field.Description: Execution Id for this side of the trade. Uniquely identifies an execution for a given day; can be used to match executions sent on other feeds.

Field.Name: Auction Id
Field.Description: Auction id for trades resulting from an auction (e.g. Complex Order Live Auction (Exposure/COLA), PIXL/PRISM/PIM Auction) or 0 if none

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction Type for trades resulting from an auction. Blank for Manual Trades.

Field.Name: Ref Trade Id
Field.Description: For corrected trades, trade id of prior trade. 0 if never corrected.

Field.Name: Ref Correction Number
Field.Description: For corrected trades, correction number of prior trade. 0 if never corrected.

Field.Name: Ref Match Id
Field.Description: For corrected trades, Execution Id of the prior trade

Field.Name: Execution Type
Field.Description: A = automatic, M = manual. A trade is automatic when it is assigned by the electronic matching engine.

Field.Name: Execution Market
Field.Description: Away execution market id for options, space for trades that are not away. The document types this field Integer; its option market values are characters.

Field.Name: Trade Side
Field.Description: B = Buy, S = Sell

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Trade price: long, fixed point with 6 decimal digits

Field.Name: Trade Contracts
Field.Description: Trade contracts

Field.Name: Side Changed
Field.Description: Y = new trades and corrections that affected this side of the trade, N = corrections that affected only contra side

Field.Name: Strategy Id
Field.Description: Complex order strategy id which this trade is associated with. Populated if either side of the trade involves a Complex Order, otherwise 0.

Field.Name: Strategy Leg
Field.Description: Leg reference (leg index starting from 0 in the Complex Order Strategy message) if either side of the trade involves a complex order or sweep

Field.Name: Reserved 8
Field.Description: Reserved for future extension

Field.Name: Occ Clearing Number
Field.Description: Same side: OCC clearing number or CMTA provided by firm

Field.Name: Give Up Occ Clearing Number
Field.Description: Same side: OCC clearing number of the giving-up firm if OCC clearing number above is CMTA, otherwise 0

Field.Name: Exchange Clearing Number
Field.Description: Same side: Exchange assigned clearing number

Field.Name: Exchange House
Field.Description: Same side: Exchange assigned house number

Field.Name: Exchange Suffix
Field.Description: Same side: Exchange assigned house suffix for market makers (badge suffix)

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: Same side capacity

Field.Name: Multi Account
Field.Description: Same side: Sub or multi account

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: Same side: Floor broker number/Executing Broker

Field.Name: Second Broker
Field.Description: Same side: 2nd floor broker number

Field.Name: Origin Market
Field.Description: Originating market of the order for market makers (FIX tag 207 Security Exchange); space when the capacity of this side of the trade is not O

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Account as specified in the order (FIX tag 1 Account)

Field.Name: Nscc
Field.Description: Same side: NSCC clearing number for a stock leg

Field.Name: Mpid
Field.Description: Same side: for PHLX, NASDAQ assigned MPID number for a stock leg; for ISE, MPID of the firm at the stock executing venue

Field.Name: Clearing Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0: Priority Market Maker (0=no, 1=yes)

Field.Name: Executing Broker
Field.Description: Executing Broker

Field.Name: Reserved 6
Field.Description: Reserved for future extension

Field.Name: Contra Occ Clearing Number
Field.Description: Contra side: OCC clearing number or CMTA provided by firm

Field.Name: Contra Give Up Occ Clearing Number
Field.Description: Contra side: OCC clearing number of the giving-up firm if OCC clearing number above is CMTA, otherwise 0

Field.Name: Contra Exchange Clearing Number
Field.Description: Contra side: Exchange assigned clearing number

Field.Name: Contra Exchange House
Field.Description: Contra side: Exchange assigned house number

Field.Name: Contra Capacity
Field.Description: Contra side capacity

Field.Name: Contra Broker
Field.Description: Contra side: Floor broker number

Field.Name: Contra Second Broker
Field.Description: Contra side: 2nd floor broker number

Field.Name: Contra Nscc
Field.Description: Contra side: NSCC clearing number for a stock leg

Field.Name: Contra Mpid
Field.Description: Contra side: for PHLX, NASDAQ assigned MPID number for a stock leg; for ISE, MPID of the firm at the stock executing venue

Field.Name: Reserved 8
Field.Description: Reserved for future extension

Field.Name: Firm
Field.Description: Firm Identifier for the order or Quote

Field.Name: Order Date
Field.Description: Date when a FIX order is received: Bits 0-6 = Year (0-99), Bits 7-10 = Month (1-12), Bits 11-15 = Day (1-31); bit 15 is the least significant bit. 0 if the order is not a GTC or GTD order.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Right padded FIX/OTTO order id or spaces. Populated with CLOrderID (or BranchSeqnbr if provided, for FIX Orders only).

Field.Name: Quote Id
Field.Description: Quote id for quotes with ids (from SQF feed v6 and higher). Right padded 1 for quotes without ids, spaces if this side of the trade is not a quote. Binary.

Field.Name: Sqf Sweep Id
Field.Description: Sweep id for order sweeps with ids (from SQF feed v6 and higher). Right padded 1 for sweeps without ids, spaces if this side of the trade is not a sweep. Binary.

Field.Name: Open Close Indicator
Field.Description: Open/Close indicator from FIX/OTTO orders. Space for stock leg.

Field.Name: Customer Strategy Leg
Field.Description: Leg reference id of a complex order as sent by the customer or spaces

Field.Name: Short Sell
Field.Description: Short sell for a stock leg: Y = Short Sale, N = Not a Short Sale, E = Short Sale Exempt, space = Not Applicable (Not a Stock Leg)

Field.Name: Principal Agent
Field.Description: Capacity for a stock leg: A = Agency Order, P = Principle, R = Riskless Principle, space = Not a stock leg

Field.Name: Supplementary Id
Field.Description: Supplementary Id from FIX orders (FIX tag 58 Text)

Field.Name: Order Indicators
Field.Description: Bit 0 = FBMS order, Bit 1 = Directed/Preferenced, Bit 2 = Post Only/ALO, Bit 3 = MKT Order, Bit 4 = ISE Directed Order, Bits 5-15 not used; bit 15 is the least significant bit. Directed/Preferenced, Post Only, ISE Directed and MKT Order are not available for Manual Trades, Trade Corrections and Cancels.

Field.Name: Origin Type
Field.Description: Origin of this side of the trade

Field.Name: Order Size
Field.Description: Size of the order/quote/sweep or 0 for manual trades

Field.Name: Order Price
Field.Description: Price of the order/quote/sweep: fixed point with 4 decimal digits. 0 for MKT Orders (indicated by the MKT bit in Order Indicators) and for manual trades.

Field.Name: Tif
Field.Description: Time In Force for the order/quote/sweep. FOK orders are returned with TIF = IOC.

Field.Name: Reserved 8
Field.Description: Reserved for future extension

Message.Name: Cancel Trade Message
Message.Description: By default CTI sends trade cancels using this message; alternatively a firm and connection block can be configured to send extended cancels with all the trade information using the Trade message with Transaction Type Z. 55 bytes.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds portion of cancel time

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of cancel time

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: CTI version

Field.Name: Send Type
Field.Description: S = Send (original transmission), P = Possible duplicate (unsolicited retransmission)

Field.Name: Option Id
Field.Description: Option id assigned by exchange daily. Zero for stock leg.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying stock symbol (left justified, space filled)

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option root symbol. Blank for stock leg.

Field.Name: Expiration
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option: Bits 0-6 = Year (0-99), Bits 7-10 = Month (1-12), Bits 11-15 = Day (1-31); bit 15 is the least significant bit. Zero for stock leg.

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Strike price of the option: fixed point with 4 decimal digits. Zero for stock leg.

Field.Name: Option Kind
Field.Description: C = Call, P = Put, space = Stock leg

Field.Name: Trade Id
Field.Description: Clearing trade Id

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade Correction Number. 0 for new trade.

Field.Name: Cross Id
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all clearing trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Trade Side
Field.Description: B = Buy, S = Sell

Field.Name: Match Id
Field.Description: Execution Id of the trade being cancelled

Bitfield.Name: Expiration
Bitfield.Description: Expiration date of the option packed into 2 bytes: Bits 0-6 = Year (0-99), Bits 7-10 = Month (1-12), Bits 11-15 = Day (1-31); bit 15 is the least significant bit

Field.Name: Expiration Day
Field.Description: Day (1-31): document bits 11-15

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Month (1-12): document bits 7-10

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Year (0-99): document bits 0-6

Bitfield.Name: Order Date
Bitfield.Description: Date when a FIX order is received, packed into 2 bytes: Bits 0-6 = Year (0-99), Bits 7-10 = Month (1-12), Bits 11-15 = Day (1-31); bit 15 is the least significant bit. 0 if the order is not a GTC or GTD order.

Field.Name: Order Date Day
Field.Description: Day (1-31): document bits 11-15

Field.Name: Order Date Month
Field.Description: Month (1-12): document bits 7-10

Field.Name: Order Date Year
Field.Description: Year (0-99): document bits 0-6

Bitfield.Name: Trade Flags
Bitfield.Description: Trade message symbol flags (2 bytes); bit 15 is the least significant bit. When available, only one of Bits 3, 4 and 5 will be set to 1 for an option.

Field.Name: Reserved Trade Flags
Field.Description: Bits 6-15: Not Used

Field.Name: Quarterly Expiration
Field.Description: Bit 5: Quarterly Expiration (0=no, 1=yes). Will be available at a future date.

Field.Name: Monthly Expiration
Field.Description: Bit 4: Monthly Expiration (0=no, 1=yes). Will be available at a future date.

Field.Name: Weekly Expiration
Field.Description: Bit 3: Weekly Expiration (0=no, 1=yes). Will be available at a future date.

Field.Name: Single Listed
Field.Description: Bit 2: Single Listed (0=no, 1=yes). Will be available at a future date.

Field.Name: Make Take Program
Field.Description: Bit 1: Symbol In Make/Take Program (0=no, 1=yes)

Field.Name: Penny Pilot
Field.Description: Bit 0: Symbol in Penny Pilot (0=no, 1=yes)

Bitfield.Name: Clearing Flags
Bitfield.Description: Same side clearing flags (2 bytes). Only Bit 0 is defined; numbered, as in the other 2 byte flag fields of this message, with bit 15 the least significant bit.

Field.Name: Reserved Clearing Flags
Field.Description: Bits 1-15: Not Used

Field.Name: Priority Market Maker
Field.Description: Bit 0: Priority Market Maker (0=no, 1=yes)

Bitfield.Name: Order Indicators
Bitfield.Description: Same side order indicators (2 bytes); bit 15 is the least significant bit. Directed/Preferenced, Post Only, ISE Directed and MKT Order indicators are not available for Manual Trades, Trade Correction and Cancels.

Field.Name: Reserved Order Indicators
Field.Description: Bits 5-15: not used

Field.Name: Ise Directed Order
Field.Description: Bit 4: ISE Directed Order

Field.Name: Mkt Order
Field.Description: Bit 3: MKT Order (0-no, 1-yes)

Field.Name: Post Only Alo
Field.Description: Bit 2: Post Only/ALO (0-no, 1-yes)

Field.Name: Directed Preferenced
Field.Description: Bit 1: Directed/Preferenced (0-no, 1-yes)

Field.Name: Fbms Order
Field.Description: Bit 0: FBMS order (0-no, 1-yes)

Value.Name: Start Of Messages
Value.Description: Start of Messages. Always the first message sent in any trading day (after ~4:00am).

Value.Name: Start Of System Hours
Value.Description: Start of System Hours. The exchange is ready to start accepting orders (7:00am).

Value.Name: Start Of Currency Opening Process
Value.Description: Start of Currency Opening Process. The options system has started its opening auction process for currency options (7:30:00am).

Value.Name: Start Of Opening Process
Value.Description: Start of Opening Process. The exchange has started its opening process (9:30:00am).

Value.Name: End Of Normal Hours Processing
Value.Description: End of Normal Hours Processing. No new orders or changes to existing orders for options that trade during normal hours (4:00:00pm).

Value.Name: End Of Late Hours Processing
Value.Description: End of Late Hours Processing. No new orders or changes to existing orders for options that trade during extended hours (4:15:00pm).

Value.Name: End Of System Hours
Value.Description: End of System Hours. The system is now closed (~5:30pm).

Value.Name: End Of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. Always the last message sent in any trading day (~5:35pm).

Value.Name: Penny Everywhere
Value.Description: Penny Everywhere: all prices are in penny increments

Value.Name: Scaled
Value.Description: Scaled: prices below $3.00 are in increments of $0.05, prices above $3.00 are in increments of $0.10

Value.Name: Penny Pilot
Value.Description: Penny Pilot: prices below $3.00 are in increments of $0.01, prices above $3.00 are in increments of $0.05

Value.Name: Closing Position Only
Value.Description: Option is Closing Position Only. Only MM origin orders can have open position in the series.

Value.Name: Not Closing Position Only
Value.Description: Option is not Closing Position Only

Value.Name: Trade Cancel
Value.Description: Trade cancel (if trade cancel messages are to be sent using this message)

Value.Name: Not Applicable
Value.Description: Not Applicable (the capacity of this side of trade is not O)

Value.Name: Yes
Value.Description: New trades and corrections that affected this side of the trade

Value.Name: No
Value.Description: Corrections that affected only contra side

Value.Name: Not Applicable
Value.Description: Not Applicable (stock leg execution or routed away execution)

Value.Name: Not Applicable
Value.Description: Not Applicable (stock leg execution or routed away execution)

Value.Name: Combo Taker Against Regular Thru NBBO
Value.Description: Combo Taker Against Regular - Thru NBBO

Value.Name: Combo Taker Against IO Thru NBBO
Value.Description: Combo Taker Against IO - Thru NBBO
